title: edge-faas-container-benchmark
description: Open, reproducible benchmarking harness comparing an always-on container deployment against reactive and predictively pre-warmed (EWMA, last-gap, moving-average, fixed-schedule) on-demand serverless deployments of an identical real-time telemetry-ingestion service, with matched-trial statistical analysis and a measured cost-latency model. Companion code and data for a manuscript in preparation.
